{{Quote|We surrender! Our village is yours. Take whatever you want.|A royal trooper surrenders to the Trade Federation|audio=RoyalTrooperSurrender.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''village''' loyal to the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] near the city of [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]]. The village was bordered by a [[Water/Legends|river]] from its western to its southern side and contained natural resources such as [[Tree/Legends|trees]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits. The structures inside the village included a [[command center]], an aquatic [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]], processing centers for the resources, [[Power core/Legends|power cores]], a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]], and several [[Turret/Legends|turret]]s.

During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the company attacked the village so that it could be used as a base to [[Invasion of Spinnaker|invade]] Spinnaker. The village's inhabitants surrendered and allowed the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] to use it as he saw fit. The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] constructed additional turrets in the village and faced attacks from Spinnaker and the [[Naboo Royal Navy]], which they were able to push back. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] then expanded their [[Army/Legends|army]] by constructing additional military buildings and were ultimately successful in eliminating the resistance of Spinnaker.

==Description==
[[File:Spinnaker_main.png|thumb|right|350px|Spinnaker, a city to the north of the village]]
A village associated with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo people]] was located south of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was also east of a [[Naboo Royal Navy base|base]] belonging to the [[Naboo Royal Navy]]. A [[Water/Legends|river]] bordered the village, stretching from its western to its southern side. It had three main entrances, with those on the northeast and northwest sides accessible by archways between the village walls. Each archway had two light [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]] placed on the inside of the village. The southern area on the eastern side led to an open [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] area full of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and populated by native fauna such as [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]], [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaas]], and [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]]. The southern entrance was blocked by a short wall with a gate accessible by a shallow part of the river.<ref name="GB" />

The surface of the village grounds was paved with bricks. The center of the village hosted a [[command center]] and was surrounded by, in clockwise order, a [[food processing center]], two blocks containing six [[prefab shelter]]s each, an aquatic [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] on the southwestern part of the river, a light turret, a [[Power core/Legends|power core]], and a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]]. The shipyard was used to manufacture [[utility trawler]]s, which, along with [[AquaHarvester]]s, were used to catch [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from the river. The area slightly north of the troop center contained deposits of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] and a [[nova processing center]]. The northern area of the village contained a [[carbon processing center]] used to store [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] from trees, a power core, and an [[ore processing center]] along with deposits of [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. In the village, [[PKN-49 worker droid]]s were utilized to gather the available natural resources.<ref name="GB" />

After the village later became a base for the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] while they launched the [[invasion of Spinnaker]],<ref name="GB" /> the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] expanded the village's defenses immediately by assigning the PKN-49 [[Labor droid/Legends|worker droids]] to build two medium turrets and two [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-aircraft turrets]] along the northern and western walls. They later expanded the military capabilities of the village with at least one [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]], another troop center, and a [[Mech/Legends|mech]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]].<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

==History==
===Captured village===
[[File:Droidekas_roll_in.png|thumb|left|350px|OOM-9's droidekas roll in to take the village.]]
The village was loyal to the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] and its [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], OOM-9 targeted the village in order to set up a base from which to invade Spinnaker. The Droid Army advanced toward the village from the south with a force of two [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]], three [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], three manned [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], six heavy [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], six [[E4 baron droid|baron battle droids]], ten [[Heavy Battle Droid/Legends|Heavy Battle Droids]], and ten [[Grenade droid/Legends|droid grenadiers]]. They met resistance at the village from eight [[Security Guard/Legends|royal troopers]],<ref name="GB" /> who rushed out of the gate to fight, but OOM-9 had the droidekas roll through into the village.<ref name="Prima" /> In response, the eight worker [[Droid/Legends|droids]]<ref name="GB" /> were intimidated and ceased their labor,<ref name="Prima" /> and a [[Unidentified royal trooper|royal trooper]] announced the surrender of the village and allowed the Trade Federation to use it however they wished, placing all of the village's surviving [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and worker droids at OOM-9's command.<ref name="GB" /> OOM-9 sent the droidekas and [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] troopers to guard the northern gates and had the mechs defend the open southeastern area.<ref name="Prima" />

OOM-9 quickly reassigned the worker droids to gather carbon and ore so the [[Army/Legends|army]] could build more turrets and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The droids built two medium turrets and two anti-air turrets and used the utility trawlers to gather fish.<ref name="Prima" /> Spinnaker sent a group to retake the village that included three heavy [[V-19 landspeeder]]s, four [[Champion (vehicle)|Heavy Champion]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcrafts]], and two [[Steadfast (tank)|Steadfast]] tanks. The Naboo Royal Navy also sent four [[Royal crusader]]s, three [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], three [[Naboo energy catapult]]s,<ref name="GB" /> and three [[Tuskcat Trooper]]s.<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> Both groups attempted to penetrate the western entrance,<ref name="GB" /> but the droids were able to repel the attackers and worked on expanding their defenses by adding an airbase, another troop center, and a mech factory to the village. Through [[Mining/Legends|mining]] the available nova [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], the droids were able to build [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|fighters]], Armored Assault Tanks, [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|missile battle droids]], the latter of which they spread throughout the village to protect from aerial attacks.<ref name="Prima" />

===Eliminating resistance===
[[File:Village_defence.png|thumb|right|300px|The Trade Federation Droid Army defends the village from the forces of Spinnaker.]]
Spinnaker's next attacking force included eight royal troopers,<ref name="GB" /> four heavy Tuskcat Troopers,<ref name="CC" /> six heavy V-19 landspeeders, two [[Champion (vehicle)|Champions]], and one Steadfast,<ref name="GB" /> while the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] continued sending [[Boat/Legends|boats]],<ref name="Prima" /> all of which the Trade Federation was able to defeat.<ref name="GB" /> OOM-9 sent a group of worker droids to build a turret and a carbon processing center on the road between the village and Spinnaker, using five Droid Starfighters and some infantry troops to protect them. Most of the remaining forces of Spinnaker detected the incursion outside the city walls and were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the effort to reclaim it. OOM-9 then repeated that strategy to claim a nova deposit close to the Royal Navy's base and subsequently defeated the Navy using fighters and pummels<ref name="Prima" />

The Trade Federation Droid Army was ultimately able to capture Spinnaker, after which they assembled [[Neimoidian trader]]s to collect nova crystals from both the city's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]<ref name="Prima" /> and from the nearby Trade Federation [[YIN-762's base|base]] commanded by the droid [[YIN-762]]. The droids also attacked a [[Unidentified Naboo town|trading town]] north of Spinnaker by assembling an [[Ocean Troop Transport]] at the village's shipyard so that it could be ferried to the town. OOM-9 achieved [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] goal of claiming 10,000 nova crystals from the Naboo before moving on to [[Capture of Theed/Legends|capture]] the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The [[Naboo Resistance]] later held the area where the village had stood, although their territory was overrun in [[Liberation of Spinnaker|battle]] with the Trade Federation.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Naboo village was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima" /> released on [[November 7]], [[2001]].<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> It then appeared in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The village appears in the third level of the Trade Federation campaign, "Spinnaker's Spoils," in which the player controls the Droid Army and occupies the village in order to achieve their objective of raising 10,000 nova crystals. At the beginning of the level, the village begins as an opposing civilization called "Naboo Village", but as soon as the player's units approach the village's command center, the village's surviving buildings, workers, vessels, and soldiers switch to the player's control. The player can expand the village by constructing buildings of their choice.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Village_anti-air_turret.png|thumb|right|300px|One of the village's anti-air turrets (center-right), which is only present on easy difficulty]]
The [[Prima Games]] guide states that a [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry post]] is present at the southern entrance of the village and that the player should destroy it,<ref name="Prima" /> but it does not appear in ''Galactic Battlegrounds''.<ref name="GB" /> The guide also states that the player risks losing the level if they damage too much of the village at the beginning, as they are placing themselves at a disadvantage by destroying units and buildings that would join their side eventually. It also states that players need to be quick in upgrading their defenses to ensure victory.<ref name="Prima" />

Exclusively in the hard difficulty version of the level, the first wave of attackers from Spinnaker and the Naboo Royal Navy are placed outside the western entrance of the village, and they begin attacking as soon as the player takes control of the settlement. In easy mode, the village has two anti-air turrets, one on the western side and the other on the eastern side, that the player acquires once the village surrenders.<ref name="GB" /> This article assumes the hard difficulty mode is [[canon]]ical within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.
